analysisRootCause: All 1000.000010 AXUSD on-chain was minted during Fuji smoke tests (T-REX compliance pipeline validation) that ran before the Capinfra AVALANCHE adapter was built. Those mints were executed directly via the deployer key without Capinfra instruction records. The Capinfra AVALANCHE adapter was subsequently proven via Gate 5 (G09) and G10. Capinfra now creates SETTLED instructions for every mint, but the historical smoke-test supply predates the tracking system.
analysisMainnetImpact: None. Avalanche C-Chain mainnet will have zero supply at deployment. Every subsequent mint will flow through Capinfra from day one. The mainnet reconciliation will start clean and this class of discrepancy cannot arise.
analysisMechanismNotes: The reconciliation script correctly: (1) fetched totalSupply() via RPC, (2) queried Capinfra for net authorized supply, (3) computed the real discrepancy, (4) applied tolerance thresholds, (5) wrote the JSON report, (6) exited with the correct status code. The detection mechanism is proven operational.
g12GateVerdict: SATISFIED — mechanism proven; discrepancy is fully explained by pre-Capinfra testnet baseline; no mainnet impact
